naslov: Jokic and the Nuggets triumph over the Pacers in Mexico City
tekst:
By Johnny Askounis/ info@eurohoops.net
MEXICO CITY – Nikola Jokic and the Denver Nuggets are used to the altitude of their home and there weren’t dizzy in the NBA Mexico City Game 2026.
Playing even higher than Denver, since Mexico City is 2.240 meters above sea level, they built a massive early lead and held off the Indiana Pacers 114-102 on Saturday at Arena CDMX.
Jokic dictated the pace from the opening tip. The Serbian superstar just missed triple-double, piling up 19 points, 13 rebounds and eight assists, as his team led by 27 points in the first half and never looked back.
“I just try to play the game the right way, and hopefully we can win,” he stressed after the game. “For me the win is the most important.”
Every time the the Sombor native touched the ball, the arena erupted with loud MVP chants, making it clear who the local crowd came to see.
“It was a really good crowd. The energy was there the whole game. I didn’t know who they cheering for us or for them. They were mixed up feelings,” mentioned Jokic.
Tyrese Haliburton was out due to injury and without him Indiana made it a seven-point game (102-95) in the fourth period, but couldn’t get any closer.
Pascal Siakam with 23 points was the top scorer of the Pacers.
It was a rougher night for Ivica Zubac. Saddled with foul trouble and tasked with guarding Jokic, the Croatian center spent significant time on the bench. Still, he made his 19 minutes count, fighting his way to 10 points, 12 rebounds, and five assists.
With the win, the Nuggets advanced to 5-3 in the 2026-27 Regular Season, while the Pacers slip to 3-7.
